title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-03-06 15:47-18:27: api-gateway: 97 of 177 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-06 15:47 and 2026-03-06 18:27 UTC (peak error ratio 0.92 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 1 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.969 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.
error_templates: authorizer: ImmatureSignatureError: The token is not yet valid (iat)

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} was a routine dependency bump; go-redis 9.5 enables client-side caching handshakes (CLIENT TRACKING) the cluster rejects.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} upgrades the library: go-redis 9.5 enables client-side caching handshakes (CLIENT TRACKING) the cluster rejects.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; pin the previous version in {file} until the upgrade is tested against the real dependency.

rca.macro: Deploy v3.2.0 of auth-svc was a routine dependency bump; go-redis 9.5 enables client-side caching handshakes (CLIENT TRACKING) the cluster rejects.
rca.micro: auth/go.mod:116 upgrades the library: go-redis 9.5 enables client-side caching handshakes (CLIENT TRACKING) the cluster rejects.
rca.remediation: Roll back auth-svc v3.2.0 -> v3.1.0; pin the previous version in auth/go.mod until the upgrade is tested against the real dependency.

action_items: Add a regression test covering go.mod (auth/go.mod).
Alert on the error signature `authorizer: ImmatureSignatureError: The token is not yet valid (iat)`.
